content.title: Use each author-entry control on the home page to reach the publishing packages page
content.intent: Prove that a visitor can use either author-entry control on the home page and reach the publishing packages page in both cases.
content.technique_notes: Applied happy-path coverage and equivalence partitioning. Grouped `Start Publishing` and `Compare all packages →` as equivalent-control variation because both source-grounded controls promise the same `/publish` outcome and changing the selected control should not change the outcome family. No boundary, negative, covering-array, or dependency expansion applied because there is no constrained input, no outcome-changing combination, and no prerequisite state. Budget ceiling 8 applied; this scenario ranked 1/3 and was kept with no eviction.
